Subject: Vendor payment setup — bank routing & invoice submission (Pioneer Logistics)

Hi Diego,

Welcome — excited to get Pioneer onboarded. As we discussed in the kickoff call, procurement needs bank and remittance details to complete vendor setup so we can issue POs and route payments. To keep this brief, please return the following by EOD Tue (PDT):

1) Completed vendor ACH/Wire form (attached is our preferred template; you can also send your fields in a doc)
2) W-9 or applicable tax form
3) Primary remit-to email for invoice submission and a sample invoice (PDF)
4) Confirmation of preferred payment method (ACH preferred; wire only for international or special cases)
5) Any payment instructions required in the remittance (reference fields, formats for PO/INV numbers)

Notes: our standard payment terms for new vendors are Net 30 unless vendor onboarding requires otherwise. Finance will approve Net45 for justified cases; let us know if that's needed and why. Once we have bank details + W-9, procurement will create the vendor record and issue the first PO.

I've attached the onboarding checklist and our ACH template to make this quick. Laura will own the vendor record creation. Markus will confirm banking/finance requirements. Ben — looping you for account visibility and to coordinate expected PO cadence.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Ops Partner | Redwood Inference

Hi Monica — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers below and I attached our bank form and W-9.

• Preferred method: ACH (US domestic). We accept wires if Redwood needs faster settlement, but ACH is standard.
• Bank details: see attached Pioneer_Vendor_Bank_Details.docx (routing/account masked in email; full numbers on attached PDF under secure channel).
• Remit-to: ap@pioneerlogistics.com — please include the PO number and invoice number in the subject (e.g., PO12345_INV67890).
• Invoice submission: PDF by email to ap@pioneerlogistics.com or upload to our vendor portal (link in the form). For AP reconciliation we need: vendor name, PO#, invoice#, invoice date, invoice amount, tax detail (if present), and cost center code.

I attached: Pioneer_Vendor_Bank_Details.docx, Pioneer_ACH_Form.pdf, W-9_Pioneer.pdf.

On a process note: our payment run is twice monthly (2nd and 16th), and ACH clears within 2 business days of the run. If you issue a PO before the 2nd, it will be in the 2nd run; otherwise the 16th.

Regards,
Diego Ramos
Director, Finance Operations | Pioneer Logistics

Diego — thank you, this is great and fast — appreciate it. Quick clarifications so procurement/finance can finish the setup: 

- The bank doc you attached lists an internal reference ID (PL-789). Can you confirm the exact account number we should use for ACH? If you prefer not to send full numbers via email, we can accept a DocuSign or secure upload link; I added our DocuSign link to the related_links field in our record for that purpose.
- For remittance, please also confirm whether you want a separate remittance email for each payment run or a single consolidated remittance. We normally send a single remittance per payment run with all invoices included.
- Confirm if any invoices will be prepaid or require milestone-based payments (so we can mark POs appropriately).

Next steps from our side: Laura will create the vendor record once banking + W-9 are verified. Markus — can you confirm whether we need a vendor risk check or any additional onboarding approvals for Pioneer? If not, we can create the vendor and issue PO #PO-2027-00421 by Tue.

Thanks — I’ll hold for your reply and the account confirmation.

Best,
Monica
